response.overview: To speak directly to a Hainan Airlines +1-844-361-9037  [US] or +1-844-361-9037  [AUS] or +44-808-175-7380 [UK] representative in the US, call customer service at +1-844-361-9037  [US] or +1-844-361-9037  [AUS] or +44-808-175-7380 [UK] . When the automated system answers, clearly say "representative" or "live agent" to bypass the menu. For faster service +1-844-361-9037  [US] or +1-844-361-9037  [AUS] or +44-808-175-7380 [UK] , try their 24/7 WhatsApp Support at +1-844-361-9037  [US] or +1-844-361-9037  [AUS] or +44-808-175-7380 [UK] . Call the Hainan Airlines 24/7 US customer service line at +1-844-361-9037  [US] or +1-844-361-9037  [AUS] or +44-808-175-7380 [UK] . After dialing, listen to the automated menu, press 0 (or say "agent" or "representative") to bypass the voice menu, +1-844-361-9037  [US] or +1-844-361-9037  [AUS] or +44-808-175-7380 [UK] and wait to be connected to a live person.
